newsitem.title: UK: GKN to leave lawsuit costs out of results-paper.
newsitem.headline: GKN to leave lawsuit costs out of results-paper.

text.p: British engineering group GKN Plc has decided not to include any provisions to cover damages arising from a multi-million dollar lawsuit in the United States in its full-year results due on Thursday, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
The paper said analysts had expected the company to announce a charge of 250 million to 260 million pounds (($387.4 million to $402.8 million) in its results.

A Reuters poll of analysts found they had expected GKN to post a rise in underlying pre-tax profits to between 360 million and 375 million pounds (($557.8 million to $581 million), up from 322.4 million pounds ($499.5 million) a year before.
